dialogues.en: "Hey Mako! Are you alone?"
dialogues.text: "Hey Mako! Are you alone?"

dialogues.jp:
屋上のフェンスにひとりでよりかかっている眞
子に手を上げる。
dialogues.en:
I waved at Mako, who was leaning on the fence of the roof by
herself.
dialogues.text:
I waved at Mako, who was leaning on the fence of the roof by
herself.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「うん。まあ、お姉ちゃんもじきに来るでしょ。
　テストじゃ時間が延びることもないだろうし」
dialogues.en:
"Yeah. My sister should be here soon. She only has one exam
today."
dialogues.text:
"Yeah. My sister should be here soon. She only has one exam
today."

dialogues.jp:
ショートカットのさらさらの髪が、気持ちよさ
そうに風に揺れている。
dialogues.en: Her short hair was streaming smoothly in the wind.
dialogues.text: Her short hair was streaming smoothly in the wind.

dialogues.en: "I hope so."
dialogues.text: "I hope so."

dialogues.en: I'm hungry......
dialogues.text: I'm hungry......

dialogues.jp:
眞子の隣によりかかり、腹を押さえる。胃の辺
りがへこんでやしないかと思ったが、幸い物理
的にへこんだりはしていなかった。
dialogues.en:
I stood beside Mako and held my stomach. I thought my
stomach might be dented, but of course it wasn't.
dialogues.text:
I stood beside Mako and held my stomach. I thought my
stomach might be dented, but of course it wasn't.

dialogues.jp: 「ありきたりな質問だが、テストどうだった？」
dialogues.en:
"I know this is a typical question, but how did you do on
the exam?"
dialogues.text:
"I know this is a typical question, but how did you do on
the exam?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「まあまあ出来てると思うけど。別に出来たっ
　て言うほどでもないけどね」
dialogues.en: "I don't think I did very well, but I think I did okay."
dialogues.text: "I don't think I did very well, but I think I did okay."

dialogues.jp: 特に不安要素はない様子で、平然とのたまう。
dialogues.en: She remained calm, not showing any concern.
dialogues.text: She remained calm, not showing any concern.

dialogues.jp: 「俺には｛き／訊｝いてくれないのか？」
dialogues.en: "You're not going to ask me the same?"
dialogues.text: "You're not going to ask me the same?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.en: "I don't need to ask."
dialogues.text: "I don't need to ask."

dialogues.jp: 疑問は、一言で解決される。
dialogues.en: She answered quickly.
dialogues.text: She answered quickly.

dialogues.en: "......All right."
dialogues.text: "......All right."

dialogues.jp:
俺は身体を起こし、どこか遠い景色を見たくなっ
てフェンス越しに下を眺める。
dialogues.en: I stood up straight and looked down from the fence.
dialogues.text: I stood up straight and looked down from the fence.

dialogues.jp:
そう、こういう時は、言わねばならぬセリフが
ある。
dialogues.en: There was something I wanted to say.
dialogues.text: There was something I wanted to say.

dialogues.en: "Look. People look as if they're garbage."
dialogues.text: "Look. People look as if they're garbage."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.en: "I don't see anyone."
dialogues.text: "I don't see anyone."

dialogues.jp:
隣で、同じく身体をフェンスから起こした眞子
があっさりと呟く。
dialogues.en: Mako replied as she also stood up straight.
dialogues.text: Mako replied as she also stood up straight.

dialogues.en: I heard the small sound of a xylophone from far away.
dialogues.text: I heard the small sound of a xylophone from far away.

dialogues.jp: 遠くから微かに木琴の音が聞こえてくる。
dialogues.en:
When I looked toward the source of the sound, I saw a girl
coming through the gate, heading toward us.
dialogues.text:
When I looked toward the source of the sound, I saw a girl
coming through the gate, heading toward us.

dialogues.jp:
音源を｛たど／辿｝ると、一人の女子学生が校門の方から
こちらにやってくるのが見えた。
dialogues.en: (Yes!!)
dialogues.text: (Yes!!)

dialogues.en:
"I told you, people look like...... hey, is that
Moe-sempai?"
dialogues.text:
"I told you, people look like...... hey, is that
Moe-sempai?"

dialogues.en:
I realized it was Moe-sempai when she moved close enough for
me to recognize her face.
dialogues.text:
I realized it was Moe-sempai when she moved close enough for
me to recognize her face.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp: 眞子も俺の視線を辿る。
dialogues.en: Mako also looked in the direction I was looking.
dialogues.text: Mako also looked in the direction I was looking.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.en: "Oneechan?"
dialogues.text: "Oneechan?"

dialogues.jp:
木琴を叩きながら歩いて来る人影は、まさしく
萌先輩だった。
dialogues.en:
A girl, who's walking while playing the xylophone, could be
no one but Moe-sempai.
dialogues.text:
A girl, who's walking while playing the xylophone, could be
no one but Moe-sempai.

dialogues.jp: 例によって目を｛つむ／瞑｝りながら歩いている。
dialogues.en: She was also walking with her eyes closed.
dialogues.text: She was also walking with her eyes closed.

dialogues.en: "Why's she arriving at school this late?"
dialogues.text: "Why's she arriving at school this late?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「たぶん、あたしのほうが先に出た後、家で眠っ
　ちゃったんでしょ。……はぁ……」
dialogues.en:
"I guess she fell back asleep after I left early this
morning...... huh."
dialogues.text:
"I guess she fell back asleep after I left early this
morning...... huh."

dialogues.en: Perhaps she fell asleep on her way......
dialogues.text: Perhaps she fell asleep on her way......

dialogues.en: "What about the exam?"
dialogues.text: "What about the exam?"

dialogues.en: I guess it's obvious......
dialogues.text: I guess it's obvious......

dialogues.jp:
溜め息をつく妹をよそに、小春日和の陽射しの
中を、萌先輩が気持ちよさそうに歩いてくるの
だった……。
dialogues.en:
Moe-sempai was walking toward us in the warm spring weather
while her sister sighed......
dialogues.text:
Moe-sempai was walking toward us in the warm spring weather
while her sister sighed......

dialogues.en: ◆Belated arrival◆
dialogues.text: ◆Belated arrival◆

dialogues.en: Mako was on the rooftop.
dialogues.text: Mako was on the rooftop.

dialogues.jp:
雑談しながら中庭を見ていると、こんな時間だ
というのに、萌先輩の登校する姿が……。
dialogues.en:
When we were looking at the garden and chatting, we found
Moe-sempai arriving late to the school......
dialogues.text:
When we were looking at the garden and chatting, we found
Moe-sempai arriving late to the school......

dialogues.en: What about her exam......?
dialogues.text: What about her exam......?
